articles.summary: Adds MOBILion's breakthrough SLIM high-resolution ion mobility technology, which separates molecules by size, shape and charge in milliseconds, complementing Waters' industry leading mass spectrometry platform, transforming samples to insights. Accelerates Waters' move into proteomics with research capabilities built for AI foundation and frontier models, pairing the unique speed and resolution of the Xevo™ MRT MS with data generation at the scale needed to power proteomics lab-in-the-loop research via Anthropic MCP and MHS protocol support. Furthers Waters' ability to take proteomics downstream to clinical applications, creating long-term opportunity to translate protein biomarker discoveries into clinical validation, as well as large-scale, blood-based screening such as for MCED and MRD monitoring.
